register.labelZh: RIP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: rip at 和 rip something off 可以描述動物猛烈撕咬物件,或某人突然用力扯下某物。；rip into somebody/something 表示批評帶有憤怒、直接而強烈的語氣。；rip somebody off 可以描述欺騙顧客;rip something off 則可以描述偷走物件或抄襲別人的作品。；rip through 可用來描述大火、風暴、洪水和爆炸迅速蔓延並造成嚴重破壞。
register.summaryEn: Rip at and rip something off can describe animals tearing at objects or people pulling things away suddenly and forcefully. Rip into somebody or something shows that the criticism is angry, direct and forceful. Rip somebody off can describe cheating a customer, while rip something off can describe stealing an object or copying another person’s work. Rip through is useful when talking about fires, storms, floods and explosions that move rapidly and cause serious damage.
contextsZh: 談論不合理收費、偷竊和抄襲
contextsEn: Talk about unfair prices, theft and copied work

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；核心表達是 rip into somebody/something。for 或 with 後面的部分只是補充被責罵的原因或所使用的言詞。；在 RIP ... OFF 中使用 him、her、it 或 them 時,把代名詞放在 RIP 和 OFF 中間。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. The core expression is rip into somebody/something. A phrase beginning with for or with only adds the reason or the words used: The coach ripped into the players. The coach ripped into the players for arriving late. The coach ripped into the players with a stream of angry words. When using him, her, it or them in a RIP... OFF expression, place the word between RIP and OFF: rip him off rip it off rip them off
